method: Inherited 49-group gate (the stale pre-R89 map-focus assertion is replaced by four current cutaway invariants; original baseline failure retained), 3 R90 presentation groups and 6 R95 regression groups. Node VM gameplay, Python image/hash verification, Three CPU geometry and loopback HTTP; synthetic positioning/damage/invulnerability as recorded by each script. Historical report files restored after each group. All groups attempted, including after a failure. A targeted retry requires identical runtime/client hashes, unchanged test scripts and revalidated successful report contents; failed-run artifacts are retained. No browser/GPU/natural-play claim.
